faqs.a: Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) structures content so search engines and AI tools can pick it as the direct answer, in Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, voice results and AI Overviews.

faqs.q: How is AEO different from SEO?
faqs.a: SEO helps a page rank and earn clicks. AEO helps a specific answer on that page get selected and shown, even when the user never clicks through.

faqs.q: Do FAQ rich results still matter for AEO?
faqs.a: Not for rich results. Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in May 2026. FAQ content and schema still help search engines and AI tools understand and extract your answers.

faqs.q: How long does AEO take to show results?
faqs.a: Early wins often appear within weeks of publishing well-structured answers. Steadier gains usually build over one to three months, depending on competition and your site’s existing authority.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best AEO agency in India?
faqs.a: Ask for real snippets and AI citations they’ve won, and how they measure them. The best AEO service in India for you reports answer visibility, not just rankings.

faqs.q: Why work with Reinvent Digital as your AEO company in India?
faqs.a: As an AEO company in India, Reinvent Digital builds AEO into your SEO, writes answers AI tools can quote, and tracks snippets, citations and the enquiries they bring.
